static const int sieveSize = 1000000;
int spf[sieveSize + 1];

void sieve() {
    spf[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sieveSize; i++) {
        spf[i] = i;
    }
    for (int i = 4; i <= sieveSize; i += 2) {
        spf[i] = 2;
    }
    for (int i = 3; i * i <= sieveSize; i++) {
        if (spf[i] == i) {

            }
        }
    }
}

void merge(vector<int>& arr, int l, int m, int r) {
    int n1 = m - l + 1;

    while (i < n1) arr[k++] = L[i++];

}

long long knapsack(const vector<int>& weight, const vector<long long>& value, int maxWeight) {
    int n = value.size();
    vector<long long> dp(maxWeight + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = maxWeight; j >= weight[i]; j--) {
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], value[i] + dp[j - weight[i]]);
        }
    }
    return dp[maxWeight];
}

long long kadanesAlgorithm(const vector<long long>& arr) {

    dp[0] = arr[0];
    long long maxVal = dp[0];
    for (size_t i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        dp[i] = max(arr[i], dp[i - 1] + arr[i]);
        if (dp[i] > maxVal) maxVal = dp[i];
    }
    return maxVal;
}

long long binarySearchGreater(const vector<int>& arr, int start, int end, int val) {
    long long result = 0;
    while (start <= end) {
        int mid = start + (end - start) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= val) {
            start = mid + 1;
        } else {
            result += (end - mid + 1);
            end = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

        a=(a*a)%p;
        x/=2;
    }

long long modInverse(long long a, long long p) {

long long modBinomial(long long n, long long k, long long p) {
    long long numerator=1;
    for (long long i=0; i<k; i++) {
        numerator=(numerator*(n-i))%p;
    }
    long long denominator=1;
    for (long long i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        denominator=(denominator*i)%p;
    }
    return (numerator*modInverse(denominator, p))%p;
}
